oracle_policy: Expected source semantics are fixed before extractor output. Compiler-native AST/IOperation inspection is independent capability evidence; it does not replace semantic assertions. Any correction to an expected fact must preserve old expectation, reason and review in the deviation record.

checks.assertion: Every nonempty inventory source unit and compound field has a concrete disposition; all schema paths and producer/evidence/query/fixture references resolve; no generic placeholder can close a requirement.
All captured file bytes/hashes match pilot manifest; byte-identical distinct paths retain distinct file identities; changing working files cannot alter prior retrieval.
Every FX-ENCODINGS exact span resolves to encoded 7; BOM/CRLF/multibyte boundaries are preserved, and invalid intervals fail.
Pilot exact entities and overloads match; broader assembly/TU fixtures pass at M2; declared members link to their declaring owner.
Every semantic fact resolves to exactly its allowed context membership; FLAG variants have no cross-context edge; repeated logical memberships coexist.

P1/P2/P3/P4 omit exactly [7,12,13]/[7,12]/[7]/[]; same canonical retained semantic IDs/values and schema definitions; re-export runs no analyzers. Compiler-established BD0.5 capture identity lists survive in every profile even when BD0.13 capture effects are omitted.
Every reference resolves to a retained record, minimal omitted anchor or explicit unresolved reference. Creating a dangling reference must fail validation.
Profile query code opens only selected profile and declared archive; P1 detail calls cannot read nearby canonical/other-profile files; source fallback is separately metered.
Test every per-unit/total/payload-byte boundary below/at/above, deterministic stable-key order, whole units, result-family selection and required metadata overhead.
Exact pilot def-use/branch/call facts pass, may differs from must, unsupported regions remain explicit; advanced semantic fixture cases pass before declared support.
External symbol descriptive payload contains only qualified identity/signature/library; no body or expanded member inventory is exported.
FX-GROUPS exact pair/occurrence/contributor counts and root visibility pass; logical and physical group identities differ; cycle evidence links to original edges.
M1 evaluated selection differs from observation; M4 FX-BUILD-EVIDENCE states and no-false-production assertions pass.
Each changed dependency class invalidates affected findings while old immutable datasets and source bytes remain addressable.
Malformed inputs, unsupported syntax, cancellation, budgets and interrupted publish are explicit failed/partial outcomes; prior valid packages remain readable.
Same canonical data/policy produces identical semantic payload/omissions excluding declared operational metadata; source and settings changes alter semantic identity.
Record all 24 fixed questions × 5 arms × 3 fresh attempts, including failures; same controlled protocol and budgets; actual usage, costs when known, citations, uncertainty and blinded grading.
